title: Recovering UFO metal in Zanesville, Ohio with Tim Taylor

tellings.quote: Yeah. In fact, I went in a machine shop, he and I, and had a piece sawed off the metal, which he took with them, and we gave the other piece back to the person that had it.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs, says that sometime between 2008 and 2010 he and a man named Timothy Taylor went to Zanesville, Ohio, to look at a piece of metal said to come from a UFO. Bledsoe tells Michels they took it to a machine shop and had a piece sawed off. Taylor kept that piece, and they gave the rest back to the person who had it, which Bledsoe tells as something he was part of himself.
